state_versions.current_state: Proposals for memory retrieval include a default LTM-first search and leveraging LLM function calling for advanced patterns. This design allows the LLM to trace a viewpoint's evolution, identify arguments that were later overturned, and determine which version of information is the most current, ensuring the system uses up-to-date data.

state_versions.current_state: The distinction between STM and LTM is defined: STM is more detailed for recent history, while LTM is more concise.
